item.title: President Lee also Received a Pistol as a Gift from the Turkish President (李대통령도 튀르키예 대통령에게 권총 선물 받았다)
item.description:
President Lee also Received a Pistol as a Gift from the Turkish President (李대통령도 튀르키예 대통령에게 권총 선물 받았다)

It has been confirmed that President Lee Jae-myung also received a pistol given as a gift by Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan to the leaders of countries attending the NATO summit held in his country. After concluding his schedule at the NATO summit on the 8th (local time), President Lee is currently on a state visit to Mongolia. (레제프 타이이프 에르도안 튀르키예 대통령이 자국에서 열린 나토(NATO·북대서양조약기구) 정상회의에 참석한 각국 정상들에게 선물한 권총을 이재명 대통령도 받은 것으로 확인됐다. 이 대통령은 8일(현지 시각) 나토 정상회의 일정을 마친 뒤 현재 몽골을 국빈 방문하고 있다.)

A Cheong Wa Dae official stated on the 11th (local time), "The firearm gift received approval for import after consultations between Cheong Wa Dae, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the National Police Agency," adding, "Cheong Wa Dae will securely transfer the firearm to the Presidential Archives under the management of the Presidential Security Service." (청와대 관계자는 11일(현지 시각) “해당 총기 선물은 청와대와 외교부가 경찰청과 협의하여 반입 승인을 받았다”며 “청와대는 해당 총기를 경호처의 관리하에 대통령기록관으로 안전하게 이관할 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Earlier, President Erdogan, after the two-day summit schedule in Ankara, presented each returning leader with a box containing a revolver pistol engraved with their names and ammunition. (앞서 에르도안 대통령은 지난 8일 앙카라에서 이틀간 이어진 정상회의 일정을 마치고 귀국하는 각국 지도자들에게 이름이 새겨진 리볼버 권총 한 정과 실탄이 담긴 상자를 선물한 바 있다.)

The model is the vintage pistol 'Gümüşay .357 Magnum,' produced in the 1990s by Turkey's state-owned firearms manufacturer MKE. It is said to be a rare model with high collectible value. Inside the box, a phrase reading "Gümüşay, the first revolver-type pistol produced in our country" is engraved in both Turkish and English. (모델은 튀르키예 국영 총기 제조업체 MKE에서 1990년대에 생산한 빈티지 권총 ‘구무샤이(Gümüşay) .357 매그넘’이다. 희귀한 모델이라 수집 가치도 높다고 한다. 상자 안쪽에는 ‘구무샤이, 우리 국가에서 생산한 최초의 리볼버형 권총’이라는 문구가 튀르키예어와 영어로 새겨져 있다.)

The barrel is engraved with the names of the leaders receiving the gifts, while the grip features the crescent moon and star emblem from the Turkish flag. In the empty space, a small card is placed that reads, "With the regards of the President of the Republic of Türkiye." (총신에는 선물을 받는 정상들의 이름이, 손잡이에는 튀르키예 국기에 있는 초승달과 별 모양이 새겨져 있다. 여백의 공간에는 “튀르키예 공화국 대통령의 경의를 담아”라고 적은 작은 카드가 놓였다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee presented a set of traditional Korean bows (gukgung) to President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh the previous day. The bow set was crafted using traditional techniques by combining materials like water buffalo horn and bamboo, chosen considering that archery is a shared traditional culture between the two countries. Additionally, archery is one of the three major events of the Naadam Festival, Mongolia's largest festival, which President Lee will attend as the guest of honor the following day. (한편 이 대통령은 전날 오흐나 후렐수흐 대통령에게 국궁 세트 등을 선물했다. 국궁 세트는 물소뿔, 대나무 등을 복합적으로 접합하여 전통 기법으로 제작한 것으로, 활쏘기가 양국이 공유하는 전통문화라는 점을 고려해 선물을 골랐다. 아울러 활쏘기는 다음 날 이 대통령이 주빈으로 참석하는 몽골 최대 축제인 나담축제의 3대 종목 가운데 하나이기도 하다.)

item.title: President Lee to Chair Real Estate Forum... Opposition: "Preordained Outcome" Ruling Party: "Collective Wisdom" (李 주재 부동산토론회 앞두고... 野 “답정너” 與 “집단지성”)
item.description:
President Lee to Chair Real Estate Forum... Opposition: "Preordained Outcome" Ruling Party: "Collective Wisdom" (李 주재 부동산토론회 앞두고... 野 “답정너” 與 “집단지성” )

The ruling and opposition parties engaged in a verbal clash on the 11th over President Lee Jae-myung’s decision to chair a major real estate policy forum on the 23rd. After the People Power Party (PPP) criticized it as a "preordained outcome forum," the Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) retorted, "Are you reaching a conclusion before it even starts?" <<> Park Sung-hoon, senior spokesperson for the PPP, said in a commentary that day, "The agenda proposed by the president—such as appropriate property tax levels, differential taxation for multi-homeowners, and the criteria for ultra-high-value homes—are all tailored to 'how to collect more taxes.' Although it seems like multiple options are available, the conclusion is already fixed. This is not about gathering public opinion but a 'preordained outcome forum' to justify a tax bomb." <<> Spokesperson Park added, "So far, numerous experts and citizens have warned with blood, sweat, and tears to stop regulatory overreach and tax-centric policies. Yet, the Lee Jae-myung administration has stubbornly turned a deaf ear and closed its eyes. Ignoring the public's desperate cries, they have ruined the market through arrogance and self-righteousness, and now claiming to 'listen to public opinion' is nothing but a political show deceiving the people." <<> Jo Yong-sul, another PPP spokesperson, also issued a commentary stating, "Amid growing criticism of an 'uncommunicative president,' President Lee hastily announced he would hold a real estate forum to hear on-site opinions. However, since he already set the guidelines at his first-anniversary press conference, saying 'there are issues with the tax system' and 'our property taxes are too low,' public concerns are mounting that this will become a mere showcase forum with predetermined answers." <<> In response, Park Kyung-mi, a DPK spokesperson, said in a briefing that day, "The forum hasn't even taken place, yet the PPP claims to know all the conclusions—what an astonishing act of prophecy. They are proving through their own commentary who is the one closing their ears with predetermined answers." <<> Spokesperson Park continued, "The president disclosed the forum's agenda to the public in advance and sought their opinions. Laying out the policy blueprint in the public square and asking the people—the true owners—first is common sense. Why should this be a target of criticism?" <<> She added, "Placing an item on the agenda is an 'invitation' to start a discussion, not a conclusion. Blocking even the discussion of tax policies on the table is no different from the self-righteousness of fundamentally suppressing the public's right to speak on real estate policy." She also said, "We will prepare thoroughly to ensure that this real estate grand forum, harnessing the collective wisdom of the people, becomes an opportunity to expand the scope of democracy in South Korea." (이재명 대통령이 오는 23일 부동산 정책 대토론회를 주재하기로 한 것을 두고 여야는 11일 설전을 벌였다. 국민의힘이 “답정너 토론회가 될 것”이라고 하자, 더불어민주당은 “시작하기도 전에 결론을 내리느냐”고 반문했다.)

item.title: Kim Eo-joon Claims "Jang Yun-gi Case Happens Several Times a Year"... Controversy Over Dismissing Tragedy as 'Supplemental Investigation Rights Public Opinion Campaigning' (김어준 “장윤기 사건 1년에 몇 건씩”... 비극마저 ‘보완수사권 여론몰이’로 폄훼 논란)
item.description:
Kim Eo-joon Claims "Jang Yun-gi Case Happens Several Times a Year"... Controversy Over Dismissing Tragedy as 'Supplemental Investigation Rights Public Opinion Campaigning' (김어준 “장윤기 사건 1년에 몇 건씩”... 비극마저 ‘보완수사권 여론몰이’로 폄훼 논란)

Pro-government YouTuber Kim Eo-joon has sparked controversy by stating, regarding media coverage of the "Jang Yun-gi case," that "this is a case that happens several times a year, yet they're using it for public opinion campaigning to argue that (the prosecution's) supplemental investigation rights shouldn't be abolished." Political circles criticized this, saying, "They're butchering a tragedy for partisan interests." (친여 유튜버 김어준씨가 ‘장윤기 사건’을 둘러싼 언론 보도와 관련해 “1년에 몇 건씩 있는 정도의 사건인데, (검찰) 보완수사권을 폐지하면 안 된다고 여론몰이를 하고 있다”고 말해 논란이 되고 있다. 정치권에선 “정파적 이익을 위해 비극을 난도질한다”는 비판이 나왔다.)

On his YouTube channel on the 9th, Kim said, "The Jang Yun-gi case itself is indeed a problematic case. But why is it being reported so extensively? Cases of this magnitude occur several times a year, yet in the past week or so, almost every media outlet has been running it as their top story." (김씨는 지난 9일 자신의 유튜브에서 “장윤기 사건은 사건 자체로 문제가 될 만한 사건은 맞는다. 그런데 이게 왜 이렇게까지 많이 보도가 되지”라며 “이런 정도의 사건은 1년에 몇 건씩이나 있는데 최근 한 일주일 사이로 거의 모든 언론에서 톱을 장식하고 있다”고 했다.)

Kim added, "The police messed up, and the (prosecution's) supplemental investigation rights are needed—that's how this case is being connected. I see the intention. They're using Jang Yun-gi to campaign against abolishing the supplemental investigation rights." He claimed, "The big framing is: 'Thanks to the supplemental investigation rights, Jang Yun-gi could be caught. The Democratic Party is trying to abolish these rights to let Jang Yun-gi slip away.'" (김씨는 그러면서 “경찰이 잘못했고 (검찰) 보완수사권이 필요하고, 그렇게 연결되는 사건이더라”라며 “그런 의도가 보인다. 장윤기 갖고 보완수사권 폐지하면 안 된다고 여론몰이를 하고 있다”고 했다. 그는 “‘보완수사권이 있어서 장윤기를 잡아낼 수 있었는데, 민주당은 장윤기가 빠져나갈 수 있도록 보완수사권을 없애려고 한다’ 이런 큰 틀의 프레임”이라고 주장했다.)

In response, the People Power Party called this "an absurd claim." Park Sung-hoon, the party's senior spokesperson, said in a commentary on the 11th, "Instead of wiping away the tears of blood from the victim who lost their life and their bereaved family, they are brutally butchering a tragedy for partisan gain. We cannot help but be appalled at this barbaric, beastly behavior." (국민의힘은 이에 대해 “황당한 주장”이라고 했다. 박성훈 국민의힘 수석대변인은 11일 논평을 통해 “목숨을 잃은 피해자와 그 유가족의 피눈물을 닦아주지는 못할망정, 오직 정파적 이익을 위해 비극을 난도질하는 금수와도 같은 야만적 행태에 경악을 금할 수 없다”고 했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Park continued, "If, as Kim Eo-joon claims, such a horrific case happens several times a year in South Korea, that is an even stronger reason for the prosecution's supplemental investigation rights to be more thoroughly preserved." He then said to Kim, "Even a conspiracy theorist should not abandon the minimum decency and common sense expected of a human being." (박 수석대변인은 “김어준씨 말대로 만약 이토록 끔찍한 사건이 대한민국에서 1년에 몇 번씩이나 일어난다면, 그것은 검찰의 보완수사권이 더욱 철저하게 존치되어야 할 강력한 이유일 뿐”이라고 했다. 그는 이어 김씨를 향해 “음모론 전문가라 할지라도 인간으로서 지켜야 할 최소한의 도리와 정도마저 저버려서는 안 된다”고 했다.)

On the 10th, the Democratic Party of Korea held a subcommittee of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee to review a revision of the Criminal Procedure Act that would abolish the prosecution's supplemental investigation rights. The party plans to pass the revision before its August 17 party convention. (더불어민주당은 지난 10일 국회 법제사법위원회 법안심사1소위를 열어 검찰의 보완수사권을 폐지하는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안 심사에 착수했다. 민주당은 8·17 전당대회 전에 형소법 개정안을 처리한다는 방침이다.)

However, the legal community opposes the complete abolition of the supplemental investigation rights. Earlier, the Lawyers for a Democratic Society (Minbyun) publicly expressed concerns, and the Korean Bar Association issued a statement saying, "In cases related to people's livelihoods, prosecutors should be allowed to conduct direct supplemental investigations." Referring to the Jang Yun-gi case, the Bar Association said, "Without the prosecution's supplemental investigation, critical omissions in judgment and evidence tampering circumstances would have been buried. This is a clear example of the need for supplemental investigation rights as a check mechanism." (그렇지만 법조계에선 보완수사권 완전 폐지에 대해 반대하고 있다. 앞서 민주사회를 위한 변호사모임(민변)이 공개적으로 우려를 표했고, 대한변호사협회도 성명을 내 “민생 사건에 대해선 검사의 직접 보완수사를 허용해야 한다”고 했다. 변협은 장윤기 사건을 언급하며 “검찰의 보완수사가 없었다면 치명적인 판단 누락과 증거 인멸 정황이 그대로 묻힐 뻔했다”며 “견제 장치로서 보완수사권의 필요성을 보여주는 단적인 예”라고 했다.)

Even within the Democratic Party, some have argued for partially preserving the supplemental investigation rights. Second-term lawmaker Hong Ki-won of the Democratic Party is preparing to propose a bill that would recognize the prosecution's supplemental investigation rights only in cases involving socially vulnerable groups, livelihood-related crimes, cases nearing the statute of limitations, or cases requested by the victim. (민주당 일각에서도 보완수사권을 일부 존치해야 한다는 주장이 제기됐다. 민주당 재선 홍기원 의원은 사회적 약자나 민생 관련 사건, 공소시효가 임박한 사건, 피해자가 요구하는 사건 등에 한해 검찰의 보완수사권을 인정하는 내용의 법안 발의를 준비 중이다.)

item.title: South Korean Prime Minister Visits Flood Damage Site in North Chungcheong, Orders “Nationwide Survey of Chronic Flooding Zones” (韓총리, 충북 호우 피해 현장 찾아 “전국 상습 침수 구역 전수조사하라”)
item.description:
South Korean Prime Minister Visits Flood Damage Site in North Chungcheong, Orders “Nationwide Survey of Chronic Flooding Zones” (韓총리, 충북 호우 피해 현장 찾아 “전국 상습 침수 구역 전수조사하라”)

Prime Minister Han Seong-sook visited Mochung-dong, Seowon-gu, Cheongju, North Chungcheong Province—a chronic flooding area—on the 11th to inspect the causes and recurrence prevention measures, and ordered a nationwide inspection of chronic flooding zones. (한성숙 국무총리가 11일 상습 침수 구역인 충북 청주시 서원구 모충동을 찾아 원인과 재발 방지 대책을 점검하고 전국 상급 침수 구역 점검을 지시했다.)

That morning, Prime Minister Han visited Unho Middle and High School in Mochung-dong to receive a report on flood damage from Cheongju officials. According to Cheongju, 50 households in the Mochung-dong area were flooded by 130mm of rain on the 8th and 9th. This occurred when a pump used to drain water from the area stopped due to overload. Cheongju officials explained that a project to expand drainage facilities to prevent flooding in the area was approved by the Ministry of Environment (now the Ministry of Climate, Energy, and Environment) in 2019, construction began in 2024, and completion—originally scheduled for June next year—was to be moved up to this year, but flooding occurred before that. (한 총리는 이날 오전 모충동 운호중·고등학교를 찾아 청주시 관계자로부터 침수 피해 상황을 보고받았다. 청주시에 따르면 모충동 일대는 지난 8~9일 강수량 130mm 비에 50세대가 침수되는 피해를 입었다. 이 구역에서 물을 빼내는 펌프를 가동하다가 펌프가 과부하로 멈추면서 벌어진 일이었다. 청주시 관계자는 이 구역 침수 예방을 위해 배수 시설을 확충하는 사업을 2019년 환경부(현 기후에너지환경부)에게서 승인받은 뒤 2024년에 착공했고, 완공을 내년 6월까지 하려던 것을 올해 안으로 앞당기려 했으나 그 전에 침수가 일어났다고 설명했다.)

Prime Minister Han urged city and provincial officials, “Please closely monitor the progress (of the project).” She added, “The ongoing construction is for preparedness beyond next year, but more rain is expected for the rest of this year,” and instructed them to devise measures to prevent immediate damage. (한 총리는 시·도 관계자들에게 “(사업 진척을) 같이 잘 살펴봐 달라”고 당부했다. 이어 “(지금 하고 있는) 공사는 내년 이후를 대비한 것이고, 올해 남은 기간에 또 비가 예상된다”며 당장의 피해를 막을 대책도 마련하라고 지시했다.)

Lee Gwang-hee, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea accompanying Prime Minister Han, said, “Seoul is prepared even when over 50mm of rain falls per hour, but we have problems with just 20-30mm per hour. We need to prepare for over 50mm of rain in the long term.” (한 총리와 동행한 더불어민주당 이광희 의원은 “서울은 시간당 평균 50mm 넘는 비가 내렸을 때에도 (대비가 돼 있는데), 우리는 시간당 20~30mm밖에 안 왔는데도 문제가 된다”며 “장기적으로 50mm 이상 비에도 대비해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Prime Minister Han responded, “We may need to review the standards (for flood prevention projects). There could be extreme weather that cannot be prevented by previous standards.” (한 총리는 “(침수 예방 사업) 기준을 다시 봐야 할 것 같다”며 “이전 기준으로는 막을 수 없는 수준의 이상 기후도 있을 수 있다”고 했다.)

Residents grabbed Prime Minister Han and appealed about the damage. One resident said, “This isn’t the first or second time flooding has occurred. Since there are no casualties and it’s just flooded, the media doesn’t cover it much. Only the residents suffer.” Another resident requested, “Please establish permanent measures, even if it costs more budget.” (주민들은 한 총리를 붙잡고 피해를 호소했다. 한 주민은 “침수가 일어난 게 한두 번이 아니다”라며 “인명 피해가 없이 그냥 물에 잠기니까 언론에도 잘 보도가 안 되고, 주민들만 고생을 한다”고 했다. 다른 주민은 “예산이 좀 들어가더라도 항구적인 대책을 세워 달라”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Han said, “You must be upset,” and added, “We’ll handle it well (with measures).” She also stated, “We may need to increase the scale (of drainage facilities).” (한 총리는 “속상하시죠”라며 “(대책 마련을) 잘 하겠다”고 했다. “(배수 시설) 규모를 키워야 할 것 같다”고도 했다.)

A resident whose home had been flooded three times said, “Having suffered this three times, I can’t trust anything the government says,” and lamented, “The bottom of Musimcheon (a nearby stream) is too high. We wanted to dredge it, but we need approval from the Environmental Office, and the procedures are complicated.” (집이 세 차례 침수 피해를 입었다는 주민은 “세 번째로 당하니까 (정부가) 무슨 말을 해도 믿을 수가 없다”며 “무심천(인근 하천) 바닥이 너무 높아서 준설을 하려고 했는데 환경청 허가를 받아야 하고 절차가 복잡하다”고도 토로했다.)

Prime Minister Han responded, “The Ministry of the Interior and Safety, the Ministry of Climate, and local governments should review this matter together.” First Vice Minister of Climate Geum Han-seung said, “Cheongju’s Musimcheon has had ongoing issues, so we’ll examine it comprehensively.” (한 총리는 “행안부와 기후부, 지방정부가 같이 이 건을 살펴봐야 할 것 같다”고 했다. 금한승 기후부 1차관은 “청주 무심천이 계속 그런 문제가 있어서, 전반적으로 (살펴보겠다)”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Han then ordered the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and the Ministry of Climate to “Conduct a full survey and data analysis of chronic flooding zones nationwide to develop customized regional measures.” (한 총리는 이어서 행정안전부와 기후부에 “전국의 상습 침수 구역에 대한 전수 조사와 데이터 분석을 통해 지역 맞춤형 대책을 마련하라”고 지시했다.)

North Chungcheong Governor Shin Yong-han suggested to Prime Minister Han, “To fundamentally prevent repeated lowland flood damage, please ensure that the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and the Ministry of Climate actively reflect North Chungcheong projects—such as expanding drainage pump stations and maintaining sewage pipes—in the budget.” (신용한 충북지사는 한 총리에게 “매년 반복되는 저지대 침수 피해를 근본적으로 막기 위해 배수 펌프장 증설과 하수관로 정비 등 충북 지역 사업을 행안부와 기후부가 (예산안에) 적극적으로 반영하도록 해 달라”고 건의했다.)

Prime Minister Han then personally inspected the drainage pump near the stream that had stopped operating during heavy rain. (한 총리는 이어서 인근 하천변에서 집중호우 중 작동이 정지됐던 배수 펌프를 직접 살펴봤다.)

Prime Minister Han ordered, “In preparation for the heavy rain that can occur frequently due to the climate crisis, relevant ministries such as the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and the Ministry of Climate should cooperate to strengthen inspection and management of drainage facilities,” and urged related agencies to “Ensure that ongoing disaster prevention projects proceed without disruption.” (한 총리는 “기후 위기로 인해 수시로 발생할 수 있는 집중호우에 대비해 행안부·기후부 등 관계 부처가 서로 협조해서 배수 시설의 점검과 관리를 강화하라”고 주문하고, 관계 기관에 “현재 추진 중인 재해 예방 사업이 차질 없이 진행될 수 있도록 노력하라”고 당부했다.)

Accompanying Prime Minister Han at the site inspection were North Chungcheong Governor Shin Yong-han, North Chungcheong Superintendent of Education Yoon Geon-young, Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Gwang-hee, Cheongju Mayor Lee Jang-seop, First Vice Minister of Climate Geum Han-seung, and Kim Gwang-yong, head of the Disaster and Safety Management Headquarters at the Ministry of the Interior and Safety. (이날 한 총리의 현장 점검에는 신용한 충북지사와 윤건영 충북교육감, 민주당 이광희 의원, 이장섭 청주시장, 금한승 기후부 1차관, 김광용 행안부 재난안전관리본부장 등이 동행했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "Just You Wait. I'll Be the One to Protect President Lee to the End" (정청래 “두고 보시라, 李대통령 끝까지 지킬 사람은 나”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae: "Just You Wait. I'll Be the One to Protect President Lee to the End" (정청래 “두고 보시라, 李대통령 끝까지 지킬 사람은 나”)

Former Democratic Party of Korea leader Jung Cheong-rae said on the 11th, "Just you wait. I'm the one who will protect President Lee Jae-myung to the end," adding, "I will achieve victory in the general election and regain power through a pan-democratic coalition." (정청래 전 더불어민주당 대표는 11일 “두고 보시라. 이재명 대통령을 끝까지 지킬 사람은 정청래”라며 “범민주연합으로 총선 승리와 정권 재창출을 이루겠다”고 했다.)

Jung, who is widely expected to run for party leader in the August 17th convention, made this statement on Facebook, saying, "The right person to unite the four presidencies (Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung) within the party, and to pursue integration and solidarity outside the party, forming a pan-democratic progressive coalition, is me, Jung Cheong-rae." He thus once again emphasized President Lee and the pan-democratic progressive coalition. (8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거 출마가 유력한 정 전 대표는 이날 페이스북에서 “당 안으로 4통(김대중·노무현·문재인·이재명 대통령) 통합, 당 밖으로 통합과 연대, 범민주진보연합을 할 적임자는 정청래”라며 이같이 밝혔다. 이 대통령과 범민주진보연합을 다시 강조한 것이다.)

Jung said, "Don't worry. The person you can trust is Jung Cheong-rae." He added, "I only follow the public sentiment and the party sentiment. I ask party members to protect Jung Cheong-rae with one vote per person," referring to the one-person-one-vote system for delegates and qualified party members that he championed during his tenure as leader. (정 전 대표는 “걱정 마시라. 믿을 사람은 정청래”라고 했다. 그는 “오직 민심, 오직 당심만 보고 간다. 당원들께서 1인 1표로 정청래를 지켜달라”며 자신이 대표 시절 주도한 대의원·권리당원 1인 1표제도 언급했다.)

On this day, Jung visited a memorial altar for the victims of the Osong Underpass tragedy in Cheongju, North Chungcheong Province, where he offered flowers and a moment of silence in tribute to the victims. (정 전 대표는 이날 충북 청주 오송 지하차도 참사 분향소를 찾아 헌화하고 묵념하며 희생자를 추모했다.)

In a lecture held the previous day in Gwangju, South Jeolla Province, Jung also stated, "I believe it was I who protected President Lee Jae-myung, and that I am the one who will protect him to the end," and "I am the one who has had the most conversations with President Lee over the past four to five years. I know President Lee best." (정 전 대표는 전날 전남광주에서 열린 한 강연에서도 “이재명 대통령을 지킨 것도 저고, 끝까지 지킬 사람도 정청래라고 생각한다”며 “이 대통령과 최근 4~5년 동안 가장 많은 대화를 한 것이 저다. 이 대통령을 가장 잘 알고 있다”고 했다.)

He said, "Those who supported Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung must all unite," adding, "Within the party, the 'four presidencies' must integrate, and outside the party, a grand unification of the pan-democratic progressive forces must be achieved. Only then can we win both the general election and the presidential election." (그는 “김대중, 노무현, 문재인, 이재명을 지지했던 사람들이 다 뭉쳐야 한다”며 “당 안으로는 ‘4통’이 통합하고 당 밖으로는 범민주진보의 대통합을 이뤄야 한다. 그래야 총선도, 대선도 이긴다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Attends Mongolia's National Day 'Naadam Festival' as Top Guest, Watches 'Taegukgi Horseback Parade' (李대통령, 몽골 국경일 ‘나담축제’ 최고 주빈 참석… ‘태극기 마상 퍼레이드’ 관람)
item.description:
President Lee Attends Mongolia's National Day 'Naadam Festival' as Top Guest, Watches 'Taegukgi Horseback Parade' (李대통령, 몽골 국경일 ‘나담축제’ 최고 주빈 참석… ‘태극기 마상 퍼레이드’ 관람)

President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Mongolia, attended the opening ceremony of the 'Naadam Festival,' Mongolia's largest national celebration and independence day event, on the 11th, the final day of his tour, as the first-ever 'top guest' from Korea. The Mongolian government honored President Lee with a horseback parade of cavalrymen carrying a large Taegukgi (South Korean flag). <<> On this morning, President Lee, wearing a formal suit with a blue tie, and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, in a white jacket, entered the second-floor VIP viewing area of the Ulaanbaatar National Sports Stadium, guided by Mongolian President Ukhnaa Khürelsükh and his wife, who were dressed in beige traditional attire. Amid applause from the audience filling the stadium, President Lee took a seat to President Khürelsükh's right. <<> After the raising of the 'Nine White Banners' (nine traditional white ceremonial flags) and the honor guard formation, marking the start of the event, President Khürelsükh moved to the central podium of the stadium and delivered the official opening address. During his speech, President Khürelsükh pointed to President Lee in the VIP section and said, "On behalf of the Republic of Korea, I sincerely thank President Lee Jae-myung for attending this festival." In response, President Lee and First Lady Kim stood up and responded with bright smiles and applause to the cheers of the audience. <<> As the stadium announcer near the end of the performances formally introduced President Lee and the First Lady once again, two riders on horseback entered the stadium track, each holding high a large Taegukgi and the Mongolian flag, and rode in large circles. The riders approached the front of the second-floor VIP viewing area where President Lee was seated, vigorously waving the large Taegukgi to show respect and honor to the top guest. President Lee and First Lady Kim, who had been watching intently with their arms resting, stood up and applauded for a while as the Taegukgi came near. <<> President Lee personally used binoculars to observe from various angles as the cavalrymen galloped around the circular stadium holding flags, and during traditional dance and song performances from regions like the Gobi and Altai. In particular, when children riding camel dolls passed by, he leaned forward to observe them closely with a smile, and he waved his hand high each time performers on traditional carriages and cavalrymen greeted the VIP section. President Khürelsükh, seated to his left, frequently gestured and provided detailed explanations of Mongolian traditional culture to President Lee. <<> Once the opening ceremony concluded, President Lee and his wife, along with the Mongolian president and his wife, simultaneously stood up from the viewing area and waved to the audience. Following President Khürelsükh's guidance, President Lee shook hands with Mongolian cabinet ministers and government officials in turn, bid farewell, and then exited the stadium. President Lee also visited an archery field, one of the three main events of the Naadam Festival, and a shagai (traditional Mongolian ankle bone game) venue to personally experience Mongolian culture. <<> Afterward, President Lee and his wife attended a farewell luncheon hosted by President Khürelsükh, concluding their three-day state visit to Mongolia and departing for home. (몽골을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 순방 마지막 날인 11일 몽골 최대의 국가적 대축제이자 독립을 기리는 국경일 행사인 ‘나담축제’ 개막식에 한국 정상 최초의 ‘최고 주빈(主賓)’으로 참석했다. 몽골 정부는 대형 태극기를 든 기마병의 마상 퍼레이드를 선보이는 등 이 대통령을 예우했다.)
